text: If you are looking for a dentist. Here is your answer. 😊👍 …

Dr. Fon, a kind pediatric dentist, is wonderful.
My child loves her.
The place is convenient with parking available.
The service is good and the price is affordable.
I had braces here before and the doctor was good. I want to go back to the same place, but the staff were impolite and spoke in a way that made me feel like I should get better service elsewhere.

The doctor is good, but the receptionist is rude. Customers can't remember appointments or the doctor's name. When calling to confirm an appointment, the staff member sighs and seems reluctant to check.
So expensive!!! Why do they charge thousands of baht for just teeth cleaning? So many little hidden fees!
The doctor is lovely and very kind.

My sibling went to the dentist and encountered a doctor and assistant who spoke rudely. My sibling has never had dental work before, so why did the doctor and assistant have to be so disrespectful to the patient? They even told the guardian to teach the patient how to open their mouth properly. The issue isn't the teaching itself, but the rudeness of the assistant.
